operators.name: custom_cat_erf

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.shape: list of tensors with the same shape except dim=1 (e.g., 2 x [512,8,160,160] -> output [512,16,160,160])
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous or non-contiguous as produced by reference)

semantics: Concatenates all input tensors along dimension 1 with the exact order of the input list
Then applies element-wise erf to the concatenated result
The output is the final erf output; debug_forward can inspect the intermediate concatenated tensor if needed by separating ops, but the contract here defines one fused op
No bias, no broadcasting (inputs already aligned); output shape is the concatenation of input shapes along dim=1
Works with 4D tensors as in reference; other dimensions follow general concatenation semantics
Concatenates the input tensors along dimension 1, preserving order
Input shapes: each tensor [512, 8, 160, 160]; output shape [512, 16, 160, 160]
Output dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0, stride [409600, 25600, 160, 1], numel 209715200
Applies element-wise error function to the concatenated tensor
Returns the final tensor with shape [512,16,160,160], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0
